   417	// List enumerates local checkpoint refs and reads each root summary, sorted most
   418	// recent first.
   419	//
   420	// When the context opts in (WithRemoteListDiscovery) and a remote ref lister is
   421	// configured, it additionally discovers checkpoints that exist on the
   422	// checkpoint remote but have no local ref yet — the "second device sees zero
   423	// checkpoints" case. Discovery is names-only (an ls-remote of
   424	// refs/entire/checkpoints/*, no object transfer): each remote-only checkpoint is
   425	// listed from its ref name alone and hydrated lazily on a later read via the
   426	// on-demand ref fetch. Remote enumeration is best-effort and additive — a
   427	// failure logs and leaves the local results intact rather than failing the
   428	// whole listing.
   429	func (s *gitRefsStore) List(ctx context.Context) ([]CheckpointInfo, error) {
   430		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
   431			return nil, err //nolint:wrapcheck // Propagating context cancellation
   432		}
   433	
   434		refs, err := s.repo.References()
   435		if err != nil {
   436			return nil, fmt.Errorf("list checkpoint refs: %w", err)
   437		}
   438		defer refs.Close()
   439	
   440		var checkpoints []CheckpointInfo
   441		seen := make(map[id.CheckpointID]struct{})
   442		err = refs.ForEach(func(ref *plumbing.Reference) error {
   443			cid, ok := ParseRef(ref.Name())
   444			if !ok {
   445				return nil
   446			}
   447			commit, commitErr := s.repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
   448			if commitErr != nil {
   449				return nil //nolint:nilerr // skip unreadable refs, keep listing
   450			}
   451			tree, treeErr := commit.Tree()
   452			if treeErr != nil {
   453				return nil //nolint:nilerr // skip unreadable refs, keep listing
   454			}
   455			checkpoints = append(checkpoints, readCommittedInfoFromCheckpointTree(cid, tree))
   456			seen[cid] = struct{}{}
   457			return nil
   458		})
   459		if err != nil {
   460			return nil, fmt.Errorf("iterate checkpoint refs: %w", err)
   461		}
   462	
   463		if s.remoteRefLister != nil && remoteListDiscoveryEnabled(ctx) {
   464			checkpoints = s.appendRemoteDiscovered(ctx, checkpoints, seen)
   465		}
   466	
   467		sortCheckpointInfosByRecency(checkpoints)
   468		return checkpoints, nil
   469	}
   470	
   471	// appendRemoteDiscovered enumerates checkpoint refs on the configured checkpoint
   472	// remote and appends any that are not present locally (tracked in seen) as
   473	// not-yet-hydrated CheckpointInfos. It never fetches objects: the ref name
   474	// yields the checkpoint ID, and a ULID ID yields its creation time, so a
   475	// discovered checkpoint sorts and displays correctly before its first read
   476	// hydrates the rest. Best-effort: an enumeration failure logs, warns on stderr,
   477	// and returns the unchanged local list.
   478	func (s *gitRefsStore) appendRemoteDiscovered(ctx context.Context, checkpoints []CheckpointInfo, seen map[id.CheckpointID]struct{}) []CheckpointInfo {
   479		remoteRefs, err := s.remoteRefLister(ctx)
   480		if err != nil {
   481			logging.Warn(ctx, "git-refs: remote checkpoint enumeration failed; listing local refs only",
   482				slog.String("error", err.Error()))
   483			// Match WarnIfMetadataDisconnected: opted-in discovery failing must be
   484			// visible on stderr — logging.Warn alone lands only in .entire/logs/.
   485			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "[entire] Warning: could not reach checkpoint remote; showing local checkpoints only.")
   486			return checkpoints
   487		}
   488		for _, refName := range remoteRefs {
   489			cid, ok := ParseRef(refName)
   490			if !ok {
   491				continue
   492			}
   493			if _, dup := seen[cid]; dup {
   494				continue
   495			}
   496			seen[cid] = struct{}{}
   497			checkpoints = append(checkpoints, remoteDiscoveredInfo(cid))
   498		}
   499		return checkpoints
   500	}
   501	
   502	// remoteDiscoveredInfo builds the minimal CheckpointInfo for a checkpoint known
   503	// only by its remote ref name. Its contents are not fetched here (that happens
   504	// lazily on read); CreatedAt is recovered from the ULID timestamp so the entry
   505	// sorts by real creation time, and is left zero for a (rare) legacy-hex ref.
   506	// ListedStub marks the entry so hydration can distinguish it from a local ref
   507	// whose root metadata was unreadable (same zero SessionID/SessionCount shape).
   508	func remoteDiscoveredInfo(cid id.CheckpointID) CheckpointInfo {
   509		info := CheckpointInfo{CheckpointID: cid, ListedStub: true}
   510		if createdAt, ok := cid.Time(); ok {
   511			info.CreatedAt = createdAt
   512		}
   513		return info
   514	}
   515	
   516	// listedCheckpointNeedsHydration reports whether info is a names-only List stub
   517	// that still needs a hydrate attempt. It keys off ListedStub (set by
   518	// remoteDiscoveredInfo), not SessionID/SessionCount zero-ness: a local ref whose
   519	// root metadata.json is missing/unreadable has the same zero fields but must not
   520	// be treated as a stub (hydration can never fix it and would re-fetch forever).
   521	// Callers that need session identity for filtering or display should
   522	// HydrateListedCheckpointInfo first.
   523	func listedCheckpointNeedsHydration(info CheckpointInfo) bool {
   524		return info.ListedStub && !info.CheckpointID.IsEmpty()
   525	}
   526	
   527	// HydrateListedCheckpointInfo fills SessionID/Agent/etc for a List entry that
   528	// was discovered by name only. It reads the checkpoint (triggering an on-demand
   529	// ref fetch when configured) and mirrors the fields List populates for local
   530	// refs via readCommittedInfoFromCheckpointTree, with one deliberate CreatedAt
   531	// divergence: the local List path assigns info.CreatedAt = meta.CreatedAt
   532	// unconditionally, while hydration only overwrites when meta.CreatedAt is
   533	// non-zero (keeping the ULID-derived time from remoteDiscoveredInfo).
   534	//
   535	// Best-effort / fail-once: on Read or last-session metadata failure it logs Warn,
   536	// clears ListedStub so callers do not re-fetch, and returns the original stub
   537	// fields (never a half-hydrated SessionCount-without-SessionID that would poison
   538	// a committedByID cache and still look "done").
   539	func HydrateListedCheckpointInfo(ctx context.Context, store interface {
   540		Read(ctx context.Context, checkpointID id.CheckpointID) (*CheckpointSummary, error)
   541		ReadSessionMetadata(ctx context.Context, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, sessionIndex int) (*Metadata, error)
   542	}, info CheckpointInfo) CheckpointInfo {
   543		if !listedCheckpointNeedsHydration(info) {
   544			return info
   545		}
   546		summary, err := store.Read(ctx, info.CheckpointID)
   547		if err != nil || summary == nil {
   548			logging.Warn(ctx, "git-refs: failed to hydrate remote-discovered checkpoint; leaving stub without session metadata",
   549				slog.String("checkpoint_id", info.CheckpointID.String()),
   550				slog.String("error", errString(err)))
   551			info.ListedStub = false // fail-once: do not re-fetch on every list
   552			return info
   553		}
   554	
   555		out := info
   556		out.ListedStub = false
   557		out.CheckpointsCount = summary.CheckpointsCount
   558		out.FilesTouched = summary.FilesTouched
   559		out.SessionCount = len(summary.Sessions)
   560		out.Imported = summary.Imported
   561		out.SessionIDs = nil
   562		lastMetaOK := len(summary.Sessions) == 0
   563		for i := range summary.Sessions {
   564			meta, metaErr := store.ReadSessionMetadata(ctx, info.CheckpointID, i)
   565			if metaErr != nil || meta == nil {
   566				logging.Warn(ctx, "git-refs: failed to read session metadata while hydrating remote-discovered checkpoint",
   567					slog.String("checkpoint_id", info.CheckpointID.String()),
   568					slog.Int("session_index", i),
   569					slog.String("error", errString(metaErr)))
   570				continue
   571			}
   572			if meta.SessionID != "" {
   573				out.SessionIDs = append(out.SessionIDs, meta.SessionID)
   574			}
   575			if i == len(summary.Sessions)-1 {
   576				out.Agent = meta.Agent
   577				out.SessionID = meta.SessionID
   578				if !meta.CreatedAt.IsZero() {
   579					out.CreatedAt = meta.CreatedAt
   580				}
   581				out.IsTask = meta.IsTask
   582				out.ToolUseID = meta.ToolUseID
   583				lastMetaOK = true
   584			}
   585		}
   586		if !lastMetaOK {
   587			// Avoid caching SessionCount>0 with empty SessionID: that shape no longer
   588			// needs hydration under the old zero-field heuristic and would poison
   589			// committedByID / --session filters. Fail-once on the original stub.
   590			logging.Warn(ctx, "git-refs: remote-discovered checkpoint hydration incomplete; leaving stub without session metadata",
   591				slog.String("checkpoint_id", info.CheckpointID.String()))
   592			info.ListedStub = false
   593			return info
   594		}
   595		return out
   596	}

   598	func errString(err error) string {
   599		if err == nil {
   600			return "nil result"
   601		}
   602		return err.Error()
   603	}

   605	// GetCheckpointAuthor returns the author of the checkpoint ref's tip commit (the
   606	// most recent writer). Returns a zero Author when the ref is absent.
   607	func (s *gitRefsStore) GetCheckpointAuthor(ctx context.Context, checkpointID id.CheckpointID) (Author, error) {
   608		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
   609			return Author{}, err //nolint:wrapcheck // Propagating context cancellation
   610		}

## Bug Analysis Report: AttributionBaseCommit Becomes Stale

```go
func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) updateBaseCommitIfChanged(...) {

  if state.BaseCommit != newHead {
    state.BaseCommit = newHead
    // NOTE: state.AttributionBaseCommit is NOT updated here!

```

**Critical Gap**: 
- `BaseCommit` is updated for ACTIVE sessions
- **`AttributionBaseCommit` is NEVER updated** ✗
- IDLE/ENDED sessions don't even get `BaseCommit` updated
- The state is saved later in `postCommitProcessSession` line 1058

   - Attribution uses `commitA` when it should account for changes between `commitA` and current HEAD

**Scenario**: Session created, agent makes mid-turn commit with no SaveStep.

    95			candidateFiles := make([]string, 0, len(opts.ModifiedFiles)+len(opts.NewFiles))

   109		var result WriteEphemeralResult

   112		// only sees contention from external `git update-ref` callers (rare).
   113		err = withShadowBranchFlock(commonDir, shadowBranchName, func() error {
   114			// Tiny CAS retry budget: with the flock held, races against our own
   115			// code are impossible. Retries cover the pathological case of an
   116			// external writer (a user invoking `git update-ref` manually, etc.).
   117			for attempt := range shadowRefMaxRetries {
   118				parentHash, baseTreeHash, gErr := s.getOrCreateShadowBranch(shadowBranchName, opts.BaseCommit)

   121				}

   123				// Get the last checkpoint's tree hash for deduplication
   124				var lastTreeHash plumbing.Hash
   125				if parentHash != plumbing.ZeroHash {
   126					if lastCommit, lcErr := s.repo.CommitObject(parentHash); lcErr == nil {
   127						lastTreeHash = lastCommit.TreeHash

   129				}

   131				treeHash, tErr := s.buildTreeWithChanges(ctx, baseTreeHash, allFiles, allDeletedFiles, opts.MetadataDir, opts.MetadataDirAbs)

   140						Skipped:    true,

   154						Skipped:    false,
   155					}

   169			// writer beat us shadowRefMaxRetries times in a row — surface it in
   170			// .entire/logs/ so operators can see a stuck shadow branch.
   171			logging.Warn(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "checkpoint"),
   172				"shadow branch CAS retry budget exhausted",
   173				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   174				slog.Int("retries", shadowRefMaxRetries),
   175			)
   176			return fmt.Errorf("failed to update shadow branch reference after %d CAS retries: %w", shadowRefMaxRetries, ErrShadowRefBusy)
   177		})
   178		if err != nil {
   179			return WriteEphemeralResult{}, err
   180		}
   181		return result, nil
   182	}

   226			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to list branches: %w", err)

   229		var results []EphemeralInfo
   230		err = iter.ForEach(func(ref *plumbing.Reference) error {
   231			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
   232				return err //nolint:wrapcheck // Propagating context cancellation
   233			}
   234			branchName := ref.Name().Short()
   235			if !strings.HasPrefix(branchName, ShadowBranchPrefix) {

   240			// entire/ prefix but isn't a shadow branch).

   242				return nil
   243			}

   245			commit, commitErr := s.repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
   246			if commitErr != nil {
   247				//nolint:nilerr // Skip branches we can't read (non-fatal)
   248				return nil
   249			}

   251			sessionID, _ := trailers.ParseSession(commit.Message)
   252	
   253			// Extract base commit from branch name (handles new "entire/<commit>-<worktreeHash>" format)
   254			baseCommit, _, _ := ParseShadowBranchName(branchName)

   258				BaseCommit:   baseCommit,

   260				SessionID:    sessionID,
   261				Timestamp:    commit.Author.When,
   262			})
   263	
   264			return nil
   265		})
   266	
   267		if err != nil {
   268			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to iterate branches: %w", err)
   269		}
   270	
   271		return results, nil
   272	}

   312		err = withShadowBranchFlock(commonDir, shadowBranchName, func() error {

   349				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),

    17	// migrateShadowBranchIfNeeded checks if HEAD has changed since the session started
    18	// and either reconciles or migrates the shadow branch accordingly.
    19	//
    20	// Reconcile path: if HEAD carries this session's LastCheckpointID as an
    21	// Entire-Checkpoint trailer (e.g. after git reset --hard to a condensed commit),
    22	// both BaseCommit and AttributionBaseCommit are updated to HEAD. The old shadow
    23	// branch is intentionally left untouched to preserve rewind data.
    24	//
    25	// Migrate path: for all other HEAD changes (pull, rebase, tool-call commits),
    26	// the shadow branch is renamed to the new base and only BaseCommit is updated.
    27	// AttributionBaseCommit stays pinned for correct attribution.
    28	//
    29	// Returns (changed, reconciled, err):
    30	//   - changed: true if either path fired, false for no-op
    31	//   - reconciled: true only for the reconcile path; callers use this to know
    32	//     that attribution must be recomputed against the new base since the old
    33	//     base has been discarded (reconcile = reset-to-known-checkpoint)
    34	func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) migrateShadowBranchIfNeeded(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, state *SessionState) (bool, bool, error) {
    35		if state == nil || state.BaseCommit == "" {
    36			return false, false, nil
    37		}
    38	
    39		head, err := repo.Head()
    40		if err != nil {
    41			return false, false, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD: %w", err)
    42		}
    43	
    44		currentHead := head.Hash().String()
    45		if state.BaseCommit == currentHead {
    46			return false, false, nil // No migration needed
    47		}
    48	
    49		// Reconcile path: if HEAD sits on the exact commit carrying this session's
    50		// LastCheckpointID, the user has reset back to the last condensed
    51		// checkpoint. Update both BaseCommit and AttributionBaseCommit to HEAD.
    52		// Deliberately do NOT rename or touch the old shadow branch — it
    53		// preserves rewind data from the discarded segment of history.
    54		//
    55		// The SHA guard (currentHead == LastCheckpointCommitHash) distinguishes a
    56		// true reset from a cherry-pick/rebase that merely preserved the trailer.
    57		// Cherry-picking a checkpoint commit creates a new SHA with the same
    58		// message; firing reconcile in that case would drop the pinned
    59		// AttributionBaseCommit and corrupt attribution for uncondensed work.
    60		// Legacy state files without LastCheckpointCommitHash fall back to
    61		// trailer-only matching for backward compatibility.
    62		if !state.LastCheckpointID.IsEmpty() {
    63			shaMismatch := state.LastCheckpointCommitHash != "" && state.LastCheckpointCommitHash != currentHead
    64			if shaMismatch {
    65				// Trailer may still be present via cherry-pick/rebase, but the
    66				// SHA doesn't match what we condensed into — fall through to migrate.
    67				logging.Debug(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "migration"), "reconcile skipped: HEAD SHA does not match LastCheckpointCommitHash",
    68					slog.String("head", currentHead[:7]),
    69					slog.String("expected", state.LastCheckpointCommitHash[:7]))
    70			} else {
    71				headCommit, commitErr := repo.CommitObject(head.Hash())
    72				if commitErr == nil {
    73					for _, cpID := range trailers.ParseAllCheckpoints(headCommit.Message) {
    74						if cpID.String() == state.LastCheckpointID.String() {
    75							state.BaseCommit = currentHead
    76							state.RealignAttributionBase(currentHead)
    77							logging.Info(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "migration"), "reconciled session to known checkpoint on HEAD",
    78								slog.String("checkpoint_id", state.LastCheckpointID.String()),
    79								slog.String("new_base", currentHead[:7]))
    80							return true, true, nil
    81						}
    82					}
    83				} else {
    84					logging.Warn(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "migration"), "could not load HEAD commit for reconcile check, falling through to migrate",
    85						slog.String("head", currentHead[:7]),
    86						slog.String("error", commitErr.Error()))
    87				}
    88			}
    89			// If SHA guard blocked, CommitObject failed, or no trailer matched,
    90			// fall through to the existing migrate path below.
    91		}
    92	
    93		changed, err := s.migrateShadowBranchToBaseCommit(ctx, repo, state, currentHead)
    94		return changed, false, err
    95	}

    97	// migrateShadowBranchToBaseCommit moves the current session's shadow branch to a
    98	// new base commit-derived name and updates state.BaseCommit. It returns whether
    99	// an existing shadow branch ref had to be migrated.
   100	func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) migrateShadowBranchToBaseCommit(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, state *SessionState, newBaseCommit string) (bool, error) {
   101		if state == nil || state.BaseCommit == "" || newBaseCommit == "" {
   102			return false, nil
   103		}
   104		if state.BaseCommit == newBaseCommit {
   105			return false, nil
   106		}
   107	
   108		// Base commit changed - check if old shadow branch exists and migrate it
   109		oldShadowBranch := checkpoint.ShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   110		newShadowBranch := checkpoint.ShadowBranchNameForCommit(newBaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   111	
   112		// Guard against hash prefix collision: if both commits produce the same
   113		// shadow branch name (same 7-char prefix), just update state - no ref rename needed
   114		if oldShadowBranch == newShadowBranch {
   115			state.BaseCommit = newBaseCommit
   116			return true, nil
   117		}
   118	
   119		oldRefName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(oldShadowBranch)
   120		oldRef, err := repo.Reference(oldRefName, true)
   121		if err != nil {
   122			if !errors.Is(err, plumbing.ErrReferenceNotFound) {
   123				return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to read shadow branch %s: %w", oldShadowBranch, err)
   124			}
   125			// Old shadow branch doesn't exist - just update state.BaseCommit
   126			// This can happen if this is the first checkpoint after HEAD changed
   127			state.BaseCommit = newBaseCommit
   128			logging.Info(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "migration"), "updated session base commit",
   129				slog.String("new_base", newBaseCommit[:7]))
   130			return true, nil
   131		}
   132	
   133		// Old shadow branch exists - move it to the new base commit atomically.
   134		if err := checkpoint.MoveShadowBranchIfUnchanged(ctx, repo, oldShadowBranch, newShadowBranch, oldRef.Hash()); err != nil {
   135			return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to move shadow branch %s to %s: %w", oldShadowBranch, newShadowBranch, err)
   136		}
   137	
   138		logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "migration")
   139	
   140		logging.Info(logCtx, "moved shadow branch (HEAD changed during session)",
   141			slog.String("from", oldShadowBranch),
   142			slog.String("to", newShadowBranch))
   143	
   144		// Update state with new base commit.
   145		// NOTE: AttributionBaseCommit is intentionally NOT updated here. Migration
   146		// renames the shadow branch but its checkpoint trees are still relative to
   147		// the original base. Attribution must diff from that original base to
   148		// correctly measure agent work captured in those checkpoints.
   149		state.BaseCommit = newBaseCommit
   150		return true, nil
   151	}

   171	// loose object) are ignored — the object will be picked up by the next gc

   177		}

    53	// writeCheckpoint writes a temporary checkpoint to a shadow branch.
    54	// Shadow branches are named entire/<base-commit-short-hash>.
    55	// Returns the result containing commit hash and whether it was skipped.
    56	// If the new tree hash matches the last checkpoint's tree hash, the checkpoint
    57	// is skipped to avoid duplicate commits (deduplication).
    58	func (s *ephemeralStore) writeCheckpoint(ctx context.Context, opts WriteEphemeralOptions) (WriteEphemeralResult, error) {
    59		// Validate base commit - required for shadow branch naming
    60		if opts.BaseCommit == "" {
    61			return WriteEphemeralResult{}, errors.New("BaseCommit is required for temporary checkpoint")
    62		}
    63	
    64		// Validate session ID to prevent path traversal
    65		if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(opts.SessionID); err != nil {
    66			return WriteEphemeralResult{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid temporary checkpoint options: %w", err)
    67		}
    68	
    69		// Get shadow branch name
    70		shadowBranchName := ShadowBranchNameForCommit(opts.BaseCommit, opts.WorktreeID)
    71	
    72		// Collect file lists once — the worktree state is stable across retries,
    73		// so this work doesn't repeat per CAS attempt. Tree-building (which
    74		// depends on the parent tree) is what re-runs inside the retry loop.
    75		var allFiles []string
    76		var allDeletedFiles []string
    77		if opts.IsFirstCheckpoint {
    78			// For the first checkpoint, capture all changed files (modified tracked + untracked)
    79			// using `git status --porcelain -z` which respects both repo and global .gitignore.
    80			// This is much faster than filesystem walk. The base tree from HEAD already contains
    81			// all unchanged tracked files. We also capture user's pre-existing deletions.
    82			result, err := collectChangedFiles(ctx, s.repo)
    83			if err != nil {
    84				return WriteEphemeralResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to collect changed files: %w", err)
    85			}
    86			allFiles = result.Changed
    87			// Merge user's pre-existing deletions with agent's deletions
    88			allDeletedFiles = result.Deleted
    89			allDeletedFiles = append(allDeletedFiles, opts.DeletedFiles...)
    90		} else {
    91			// For subsequent checkpoints, only include modified/new files.
    92			// Filter out gitignored files — agent transcripts may report files like .env
    93			// that exist on disk but are gitignored. Without filtering, secrets in gitignored
    94			// files would leak into the shadow branch and could be pushed to remotes.
    95			candidateFiles := make([]string, 0, len(opts.ModifiedFiles)+len(opts.NewFiles))
    96			candidateFiles = append(candidateFiles, opts.ModifiedFiles...)
    97			candidateFiles = append(candidateFiles, opts.NewFiles...)
    98			allFiles = filterGitIgnoredFiles(ctx, s.repo, candidateFiles)
    99			allDeletedFiles = opts.DeletedFiles
   100		}
   101	
   102		commitMsg := trailers.FormatShadowCommit(opts.CommitMessage, opts.MetadataDir, opts.SessionID)
   103	
   104		commonDir, err := s.repoCommonDir(ctx)
   105		if err != nil {
   106			return WriteEphemeralResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to resolve repo dirs: %w", err)
   107		}
   108	
   109		var result WriteEphemeralResult
   110		// withShadowBranchFlock serializes all writers targeting this shadow
   111		// branch — across goroutines and across processes — so the inner CAS
   112		// only sees contention from external `git update-ref` callers (rare).
   113		err = withShadowBranchFlock(commonDir, shadowBranchName, func() error {
   114			// Tiny CAS retry budget: with the flock held, races against our own
   115			// code are impossible. Retries cover the pathological case of an
   116			// external writer (a user invoking `git update-ref` manually, etc.).
   117			for attempt := range shadowRefMaxRetries {
   118				parentHash, baseTreeHash, gErr := s.getOrCreateShadowBranch(shadowBranchName, opts.BaseCommit)
   119				if gErr != nil {
   120					return fmt.Errorf("failed to get shadow branch: %w", gErr)
   121				}
   122	
   123				// Get the last checkpoint's tree hash for deduplication
   124				var lastTreeHash plumbing.Hash
   125				if parentHash != plumbing.ZeroHash {
   126					if lastCommit, lcErr := s.repo.CommitObject(parentHash); lcErr == nil {
   127						lastTreeHash = lastCommit.TreeHash
   128					}
   129				}
   130	
   131				treeHash, tErr := s.buildTreeWithChanges(ctx, baseTreeHash, allFiles, allDeletedFiles, opts.MetadataDir, opts.MetadataDirAbs)
   132				if tErr != nil {
   133					return fmt.Errorf("failed to build tree: %w", tErr)
   134				}
   135	
   136				// Deduplication: skip if tree hash matches the current shadow tip.
   137				if lastTreeHash != plumbing.ZeroHash && treeHash == lastTreeHash {
   138					result = WriteEphemeralResult{
   139						CommitHash: parentHash,
   140						Skipped:    true,
   141					}
   142					return nil
   143				}
   144	
   145				commitHash, cErr := CreateCommit(ctx, s.repo, treeHash, parentHash, commitMsg, opts.AuthorName, opts.AuthorEmail)
   146				if cErr != nil {
   147					return fmt.Errorf("failed to create commit: %w", cErr)
   148				}
   149	
   150				refErr := casUpdateShadowBranchRef(ctx, s.repo, shadowBranchName, commitHash, parentHash)
   151				if refErr == nil {
   152					result = WriteEphemeralResult{
   153						CommitHash: commitHash,
   154						Skipped:    false,
   155					}
   156					return nil
   157				}
   158				if !errors.Is(refErr, ErrShadowRefBusy) {
   159					return fmt.Errorf("failed to update shadow branch reference: %w", refErr)
   160				}
   161				// Our commit is now dangling — best-effort remove it so we don't
   162				// leak loose objects across many losing attempts.
   163				tryDeleteLooseObject(commonDir, commitHash)
   164				if bErr := shadowRefBackoff(ctx, attempt); bErr != nil {
   165					return bErr
   166				}
   167			}
   168			// Retry budget exhausted. With the flock held this means an external
   169			// writer beat us shadowRefMaxRetries times in a row — surface it in
   170			// .entire/logs/ so operators can see a stuck shadow branch.
   171			logging.Warn(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "checkpoint"),
   172				"shadow branch CAS retry budget exhausted",
   173				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   174				slog.Int("retries", shadowRefMaxRetries),
   175			)
   176			return fmt.Errorf("failed to update shadow branch reference after %d CAS retries: %w", shadowRefMaxRetries, ErrShadowRefBusy)
   177		})
   178		if err != nil {
   179			return WriteEphemeralResult{}, err
   180		}
   181		return result, nil
   182	}

   184	// Read reads the latest checkpoint from a shadow branch.
   185	// Returns nil if the shadow branch doesn't exist.
   186	// worktreeID should be empty for main worktree or the internal git worktree name for linked worktrees.
   187	func (s *ephemeralStore) Read(ctx context.Context, baseCommit, worktreeID string) (*ReadEphemeralResult, error) {
   188		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
   189			return nil, err //nolint:wrapcheck // Propagating context cancellation
   190		}
   191	
   192		shadowBranchName := ShadowBranchNameForCommit(baseCommit, worktreeID)
   193		refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   194	
   195		ref, err := s.repo.Reference(refName, true)
   196		if err != nil {
   197			return nil, nil //nolint:nilnil,nilerr // Branch not found is an expected case
   198		}
   199	
   200		commit, err := s.repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
   201		if err != nil {
   202			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit object: %w", err)
   203		}
   204	
   205		// Extract session ID and metadata dir from commit trailers
   206		sessionID, _ := trailers.ParseSession(commit.Message)
   207		metadataDir, _ := trailers.ParseMetadata(commit.Message)
   208

   210			CommitHash:  ref.Hash(),
   211			TreeHash:    commit.TreeHash,
   212			SessionID:   sessionID,
   213			MetadataDir: metadataDir,
   214			Timestamp:   commit.Author.When,
   215		}, nil
   216	}

   218	// List lists all shadow branches with their checkpoint info.
   219	func (s *ephemeralStore) List(ctx context.Context) ([]EphemeralInfo, error) {
   220		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
   221			return nil, err //nolint:wrapcheck // Propagating context cancellation
   222		}
   223	
   224		iter, err := s.repo.Branches()
   225		if err != nil {
   226			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to list branches: %w", err)
   227		}
   228	
   229		var results []EphemeralInfo
   230		err = iter.ForEach(func(ref *plumbing.Reference) error {
   231			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
   232				return err //nolint:wrapcheck // Propagating context cancellation
   233			}
   234			branchName := ref.Name().Short()
   235			if !strings.HasPrefix(branchName, ShadowBranchPrefix) {
   236				return nil
   237			}
   238	
   239			// Skip the primary metadata ref when it's a branch (shares the
   240			// entire/ prefix but isn't a shadow branch).
   241			if s.refs.Primary.IsBranch() && branchName == s.refs.Primary.Short() {
   242				return nil
   243			}
   244	
   245			commit, commitErr := s.repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
   246			if commitErr != nil {
   247				//nolint:nilerr // Skip branches we can't read (non-fatal)
   248				return nil
   249			}
   250	
   251			sessionID, _ := trailers.ParseSession(commit.Message)
   252	
   253			// Extract base commit from branch name (handles new "entire/<commit>-<worktreeHash>" format)
   254			baseCommit, _, _ := ParseShadowBranchName(branchName)
   255	
   256			results = append(results, EphemeralInfo{
   257				BranchName:   branchName,
   258				BaseCommit:   baseCommit,
   259				LatestCommit: ref.Hash(),
   260				SessionID:    sessionID,
   261				Timestamp:    commit.Author.When,
   262			})
   263	
   264			return nil
   265		})
   266	
   267		if err != nil {
   268			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to iterate branches: %w", err)
   269		}
   270	
   271		return results, nil
   272	}

   274	// writeTask writes a task checkpoint to a shadow branch.
   275	// Task checkpoints include both code changes and task-specific metadata.

   280			return plumbing.ZeroHash, errors.New("BaseCommit is required for task checkpoint")
   281		}
   282	
   283		// Validate identifiers to prevent path traversal and malformed data
   284		if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(opts.SessionID); err != nil {
   285			return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("invalid task checkpoint options: %w", err)
   286		}
   287		if err := validation.ValidateToolUseID(opts.ToolUseID); err != nil {
   288			return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("invalid task checkpoint options: %w", err)
   289		}

   291			return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("invalid task checkpoint options: %w", err)

   294		// Get shadow branch name
   295		shadowBranchName := ShadowBranchNameForCommit(opts.BaseCommit, opts.WorktreeID)
   296	
   297		// Collect all files to include in the commit.
   298		// Filter out gitignored files — subagent transcripts may report files like .env
   299		// that exist on disk but are gitignored. Without filtering, secrets would leak
   300		// into the shadow branch.
   301		candidateFiles := make([]string, 0, len(opts.ModifiedFiles)+len(opts.NewFiles))
   302		candidateFiles = append(candidateFiles, opts.ModifiedFiles...)
   303		candidateFiles = append(candidateFiles, opts.NewFiles...)
   304		allFiles := filterGitIgnoredFiles(ctx, s.repo, candidateFiles)
   305	
   306		commonDir, err := s.repoCommonDir(ctx)
   307		if err != nil {
   308			return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to resolve repo dirs: %w", err)
   309		}
   310	
   311		var resultHash plumbing.Hash
   312		err = withShadowBranchFlock(commonDir, shadowBranchName, func() error {
   313			for attempt := range shadowRefMaxRetries {
   314				parentHash, baseTreeHash, gErr := s.getOrCreateShadowBranch(shadowBranchName, opts.BaseCommit)
   315				if gErr != nil {
   316					return fmt.Errorf("failed to get shadow branch: %w", gErr)
   317				}
   318	
   319				newTreeHash, tErr := s.buildTreeWithChanges(ctx, baseTreeHash, allFiles, opts.DeletedFiles, "", "")
   320				if tErr != nil {
   321					return fmt.Errorf("failed to build tree: %w", tErr)

   324				newTreeHash, tErr = s.addTaskMetadataToTree(ctx, newTreeHash, opts)
   325				if tErr != nil {
   326					return fmt.Errorf("failed to add task metadata: %w", tErr)
   327				}

   329				commitHash, cErr := CreateCommit(ctx, s.repo, newTreeHash, parentHash, opts.CommitMessage, opts.AuthorName, opts.AuthorEmail)
   330				if cErr != nil {
   331					return fmt.Errorf("failed to create commit: %w", cErr)
   332				}
   333

   335				if refErr == nil {
   336					resultHash = commitHash
   337					return nil
   338				}
   339				if !errors.Is(refErr, ErrShadowRefBusy) {
   340					return fmt.Errorf("failed to update shadow branch reference: %w", refErr)
   341				}
   342				tryDeleteLooseObject(commonDir, commitHash)

   344					return bErr
   345				}
   346			}
   347			logging.Warn(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "checkpoint"),
   348				"shadow branch CAS retry budget exhausted (task checkpoint)",
   349				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   350				slog.Int("retries", shadowRefMaxRetries),
   351			)
   352			return fmt.Errorf("failed to update shadow branch reference after %d CAS retries: %w", shadowRefMaxRetries, ErrShadowRefBusy)
   353		})
   354		if err != nil {
   355			return plumbing.ZeroHash, err
   356		}
   357		return resultHash, nil
   358	}

    17	// migrateShadowBranchIfNeeded checks if HEAD has changed since the session started
    18	// and either reconciles or migrates the shadow branch accordingly.
    19	//
    20	// Reconcile path: if HEAD carries this session's LastCheckpointID as an
    21	// Entire-Checkpoint trailer (e.g. after git reset --hard to a condensed commit),
    22	// both BaseCommit and AttributionBaseCommit are updated to HEAD. The old shadow
    23	// branch is intentionally left untouched to preserve rewind data.
    24	//
    25	// Migrate path: for all other HEAD changes (pull, rebase, tool-call commits),
    26	// the shadow branch is renamed to the new base and only BaseCommit is updated.
    27	// AttributionBaseCommit stays pinned for correct attribution.
    28	//
    29	// Returns (changed, reconciled, err):
    30	//   - changed: true if either path fired, false for no-op
    31	//   - reconciled: true only for the reconcile path; callers use this to know
    32	//     that attribution must be recomputed against the new base since the old
    33	//     base has been discarded (reconcile = reset-to-known-checkpoint)
    34	func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) migrateShadowBranchIfNeeded(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, state *SessionState) (bool, bool, error) {
    35		if state == nil || state.BaseCommit == "" {
    36			return false, false, nil
    37		}
    38	
    39		head, err := repo.Head()
    40		if err != nil {
    41			return false, false, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD: %w", err)
    42		}
    43	
    44		currentHead := head.Hash().String()
    45		if state.BaseCommit == currentHead {
    46			return false, false, nil // No migration needed
    47		}
    48	
    49		// Reconcile path: if HEAD sits on the exact commit carrying this session's
    50		// LastCheckpointID, the user has reset back to the last condensed
    51		// checkpoint. Update both BaseCommit and AttributionBaseCommit to HEAD.
    52		// Deliberately do NOT rename or touch the old shadow branch — it
    53		// preserves rewind data from the discarded segment of history.
    54		//
    55		// The SHA guard (currentHead == LastCheckpointCommitHash) distinguishes a
    56		// true reset from a cherry-pick/rebase that merely preserved the trailer.
    57		// Cherry-picking a checkpoint commit creates a new SHA with the same
    58		// message; firing reconcile in that case would drop the pinned
    59		// AttributionBaseCommit and corrupt attribution for uncondensed work.
    60		// Legacy state files without LastCheckpointCommitHash fall back to
    61		// trailer-only matching for backward compatibility.
    62		if !state.LastCheckpointID.IsEmpty() {
    63			shaMismatch := state.LastCheckpointCommitHash != "" && state.LastCheckpointCommitHash != currentHead
    64			if shaMismatch {
    65				// Trailer may still be present via cherry-pick/rebase, but the
    66				// SHA doesn't match what we condensed into — fall through to migrate.
    67				logging.Debug(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "migration"), "reconcile skipped: HEAD SHA does not match LastCheckpointCommitHash",
    68					slog.String("head", currentHead[:7]),
    69					slog.String("expected", state.LastCheckpointCommitHash[:7]))
    70			} else {
    71				headCommit, commitErr := repo.CommitObject(head.Hash())
    72				if commitErr == nil {
    73					for _, cpID := range trailers.ParseAllCheckpoints(headCommit.Message) {
    74						if cpID.String() == state.LastCheckpointID.String() {
    75							state.BaseCommit = currentHead
    76							state.RealignAttributionBase(currentHead)
    77							logging.Info(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "migration"), "reconciled session to known checkpoint on HEAD",
    78								slog.String("checkpoint_id", state.LastCheckpointID.String()),
    79								slog.String("new_base", currentHead[:7]))
    80							return true, true, nil
    81						}
    82					}
    83				} else {
    84					logging.Warn(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "migration"), "could not load HEAD commit for reconcile check, falling through to migrate",
    85						slog.String("head", currentHead[:7]),
    86						slog.String("error", commitErr.Error()))
    87				}
    88			}
    89			// If SHA guard blocked, CommitObject failed, or no trailer matched,
    90			// fall through to the existing migrate path below.
    91		}
    92	
    93		changed, err := s.migrateShadowBranchToBaseCommit(ctx, repo, state, currentHead)
    94		return changed, false, err
    95	}

    97	// migrateShadowBranchToBaseCommit moves the current session's shadow branch to a
    98	// new base commit-derived name and updates state.BaseCommit. It returns whether
    99	// an existing shadow branch ref had to be migrated.
   100	func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) migrateShadowBranchToBaseCommit(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, state *SessionState, newBaseCommit string) (bool, error) {
   101		if state == nil || state.BaseCommit == "" || newBaseCommit == "" {
   102			return false, nil
   103		}
   104		if state.BaseCommit == newBaseCommit {
   105			return false, nil
   106		}
   107	
   108		// Base commit changed - check if old shadow branch exists and migrate it
   109		oldShadowBranch := checkpoint.ShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   110		newShadowBranch := checkpoint.ShadowBranchNameForCommit(newBaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   111	
   112		// Guard against hash prefix collision: if both commits produce the same
   113		// shadow branch name (same 7-char prefix), just update state - no ref rename needed
   114		if oldShadowBranch == newShadowBranch {
   115			state.BaseCommit = newBaseCommit
   116			return true, nil
   117		}
   118	
   119		oldRefName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(oldShadowBranch)
   120		oldRef, err := repo.Reference(oldRefName, true)
   121		if err != nil {
   122			if !errors.Is(err, plumbing.ErrReferenceNotFound) {
   123				return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to read shadow branch %s: %w", oldShadowBranch, err)
   124			}
   125			// Old shadow branch doesn't exist - just update state.BaseCommit
   126			// This can happen if this is the first checkpoint after HEAD changed
   127			state.BaseCommit = newBaseCommit
   128			logging.Info(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "migration"), "updated session base commit",
   129				slog.String("new_base", newBaseCommit[:7]))
   130			return true, nil
   131		}
   132	
   133		// Old shadow branch exists - move it to the new base commit atomically.
   134		if err := checkpoint.MoveShadowBranchIfUnchanged(ctx, repo, oldShadowBranch, newShadowBranch, oldRef.Hash()); err != nil {
   135			return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to move shadow branch %s to %s: %w", oldShadowBranch, newShadowBranch, err)
   136		}
   137	
   138		logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "migration")
   139	
   140		logging.Info(logCtx, "moved shadow branch (HEAD changed during session)",
   141			slog.String("from", oldShadowBranch),
   142			slog.String("to", newShadowBranch))
   143	
   144		// Update state with new base commit.
   145		// NOTE: AttributionBaseCommit is intentionally NOT updated here. Migration
   146		// renames the shadow branch but its checkpoint trees are still relative to
   147		// the original base. Attribution must diff from that original base to
   148		// correctly measure agent work captured in those checkpoints.
   149		state.BaseCommit = newBaseCommit
   150		return true, nil
   151	}

   168	// tryDeleteLooseObject best-effort removes a loose object file. Used to

   171	// loose object) are ignored — the object will be picked up by the next gc

    46	// HashWorktreeID returns a short hash of the worktree identifier.
    47	// Used to create unique shadow branch names per worktree.
    48	func HashWorktreeID(worktreeID string) string {

    53	// writeCheckpoint writes a temporary checkpoint to a shadow branch.
    54	// Shadow branches are named entire/<base-commit-short-hash>.
    55	// Returns the result containing commit hash and whether it was skipped.
    56	// If the new tree hash matches the last checkpoint's tree hash, the checkpoint
    57	// is skipped to avoid duplicate commits (deduplication).
    58	func (s *ephemeralStore) writeCheckpoint(ctx context.Context, opts WriteEphemeralOptions) (WriteEphemeralResult, error) {
    59		// Validate base commit - required for shadow branch naming
    60		if opts.BaseCommit == "" {
    61			return WriteEphemeralResult{}, errors.New("BaseCommit is required for temporary checkpoint")
    62		}
    63	
    64		// Validate session ID to prevent path traversal
    65		if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(opts.SessionID); err != nil {
    66			return WriteEphemeralResult{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid temporary checkpoint options: %w", err)
    67		}
    68	
    69		// Get shadow branch name
    70		shadowBranchName := ShadowBranchNameForCommit(opts.BaseCommit, opts.WorktreeID)
    71	
    72		// Collect file lists once — the worktree state is stable across retries,
    73		// so this work doesn't repeat per CAS attempt. Tree-building (which
    74		// depends on the parent tree) is what re-runs inside the retry loop.
    75		var allFiles []string
    76		var allDeletedFiles []string
    77		if opts.IsFirstCheckpoint {
    78			// For the first checkpoint, capture all changed files (modified tracked + untracked)
    79			// using `git status --porcelain -z` which respects both repo and global .gitignore.
    80			// This is much faster than filesystem walk. The base tree from HEAD already contains
    81			// all unchanged tracked files. We also capture user's pre-existing deletions.
    82			result, err := collectChangedFiles(ctx, s.repo)
    83			if err != nil {
    84				return WriteEphemeralResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to collect changed files: %w", err)
    85			}
    86			allFiles = result.Changed
    87			// Merge user's pre-existing deletions with agent's deletions
    88			allDeletedFiles = result.Deleted
    89			allDeletedFiles = append(allDeletedFiles, opts.DeletedFiles...)
    90		} else {
    91			// For subsequent checkpoints, only include modified/new files.
    92			// Filter out gitignored files — agent transcripts may report files like .env
    93			// that exist on disk but are gitignored. Without filtering, secrets in gitignored
    94			// files would leak into the shadow branch and could be pushed to remotes.
    95			candidateFiles := make([]string, 0, len(opts.ModifiedFiles)+len(opts.NewFiles))
    96			candidateFiles = append(candidateFiles, opts.ModifiedFiles...)
    97			candidateFiles = append(candidateFiles, opts.NewFiles...)
    98			allFiles = filterGitIgnoredFiles(ctx, s.repo, candidateFiles)
    99			allDeletedFiles = opts.DeletedFiles
   100		}
   101	
   102		commitMsg := trailers.FormatShadowCommit(opts.CommitMessage, opts.MetadataDir, opts.SessionID)
   103	
   104		commonDir, err := s.repoCommonDir(ctx)
   105		if err != nil {
   106			return WriteEphemeralResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to resolve repo dirs: %w", err)
   107		}
   108	
   109		var result WriteEphemeralResult
   110		// withShadowBranchFlock serializes all writers targeting this shadow
   111		// branch — across goroutines and across processes — so the inner CAS
   112		// only sees contention from external `git update-ref` callers (rare).
   113		err = withShadowBranchFlock(commonDir, shadowBranchName, func() error {
   114			// Tiny CAS retry budget: with the flock held, races against our own
   115			// code are impossible. Retries cover the pathological case of an
   116			// external writer (a user invoking `git update-ref` manually, etc.).
   117			for attempt := range shadowRefMaxRetries {
   118				parentHash, baseTreeHash, gErr := s.getOrCreateShadowBranch(shadowBranchName, opts.BaseCommit)
   119				if gErr != nil {
   120					return fmt.Errorf("failed to get shadow branch: %w", gErr)
   121				}
   122	
   123				// Get the last checkpoint's tree hash for deduplication
   124				var lastTreeHash plumbing.Hash
   125				if parentHash != plumbing.ZeroHash {
   126					if lastCommit, lcErr := s.repo.CommitObject(parentHash); lcErr == nil {
   127						lastTreeHash = lastCommit.TreeHash
   128					}
   129				}
   130	
   131				treeHash, tErr := s.buildTreeWithChanges(ctx, baseTreeHash, allFiles, allDeletedFiles, opts.MetadataDir, opts.MetadataDirAbs)
   132				if tErr != nil {
   133					return fmt.Errorf("failed to build tree: %w", tErr)
   134				}
   135	
   136				// Deduplication: skip if tree hash matches the current shadow tip.
   137				if lastTreeHash != plumbing.ZeroHash && treeHash == lastTreeHash {
   138					result = WriteEphemeralResult{
   139						CommitHash: parentHash,
   140						Skipped:    true,
   141					}
   142					return nil
   143				}
   144	
   145				commitHash, cErr := CreateCommit(ctx, s.repo, treeHash, parentHash, commitMsg, opts.AuthorName, opts.AuthorEmail)
   146				if cErr != nil {
   147					return fmt.Errorf("failed to create commit: %w", cErr)
   148				}
   149	
   150				refErr := casUpdateShadowBranchRef(ctx, s.repo, shadowBranchName, commitHash, parentHash)
   151				if refErr == nil {
   152					result = WriteEphemeralResult{
   153						CommitHash: commitHash,
   154						Skipped:    false,
   155					}
   156					return nil
   157				}
   158				if !errors.Is(refErr, ErrShadowRefBusy) {
   159					return fmt.Errorf("failed to update shadow branch reference: %w", refErr)
   160				}
   161				// Our commit is now dangling — best-effort remove it so we don't
   162				// leak loose objects across many losing attempts.
   163				tryDeleteLooseObject(commonDir, commitHash)
   164				if bErr := shadowRefBackoff(ctx, attempt); bErr != nil {
   165					return bErr
   166				}
   167			}
   168			// Retry budget exhausted. With the flock held this means an external
   169			// writer beat us shadowRefMaxRetries times in a row — surface it in
   170			// .entire/logs/ so operators can see a stuck shadow branch.
   171			logging.Warn(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "checkpoint"),
   172				"shadow branch CAS retry budget exhausted",
   173				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   174				slog.Int("retries", shadowRefMaxRetries),
   175			)
   176			return fmt.Errorf("failed to update shadow branch reference after %d CAS retries: %w", shadowRefMaxRetries, ErrShadowRefBusy)
   177		})
   178		if err != nil {
   179			return WriteEphemeralResult{}, err
   180		}
   181		return result, nil
   182	}

   184	// Read reads the latest checkpoint from a shadow branch.
   185	// Returns nil if the shadow branch doesn't exist.
   186	// worktreeID should be empty for main worktree or the internal git worktree name for linked worktrees.
   187	func (s *ephemeralStore) Read(ctx context.Context, baseCommit, worktreeID string) (*ReadEphemeralResult, error) {
   188		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
   189			return nil, err //nolint:wrapcheck // Propagating context cancellation
   190		}
   191	
   192		shadowBranchName := ShadowBranchNameForCommit(baseCommit, worktreeID)
   193		refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   194	
   195		ref, err := s.repo.Reference(refName, true)
   196		if err != nil {
   197			return nil, nil //nolint:nilnil,nilerr // Branch not found is an expected case
   198		}
   199	
   200		commit, err := s.repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
   201		if err != nil {
   202			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit object: %w", err)
   203		}
   204	
   205		// Extract session ID and metadata dir from commit trailers
   206		sessionID, _ := trailers.ParseSession(commit.Message)
   207		metadataDir, _ := trailers.ParseMetadata(commit.Message)
   208	
   209		return &ReadEphemeralResult{
   210			CommitHash:  ref.Hash(),
   211			TreeHash:    commit.TreeHash,
   212			SessionID:   sessionID,
   213			MetadataDir: metadataDir,
   214			Timestamp:   commit.Author.When,
   215		}, nil
   216	}

   218	// List lists all shadow branches with their checkpoint info.
   219	func (s *ephemeralStore) List(ctx context.Context) ([]EphemeralInfo, error) {
   220		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
   221			return nil, err //nolint:wrapcheck // Propagating context cancellation
   222		}
   223	
   224		iter, err := s.repo.Branches()
   225		if err != nil {
   226			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to list branches: %w", err)
   227		}
   228	
   229		var results []EphemeralInfo
   230		err = iter.ForEach(func(ref *plumbing.Reference) error {
   231			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
   232				return err //nolint:wrapcheck // Propagating context cancellation
   233			}
   234			branchName := ref.Name().Short()
   235			if !strings.HasPrefix(branchName, ShadowBranchPrefix) {
   236				return nil
   237			}
   238	
   239			// Skip the primary metadata ref when it's a branch (shares the
   240			// entire/ prefix but isn't a shadow branch).
   241			if s.refs.Primary.IsBranch() && branchName == s.refs.Primary.Short() {
   242				return nil
   243			}
   244	
   245			commit, commitErr := s.repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
   246			if commitErr != nil {
   247				//nolint:nilerr // Skip branches we can't read (non-fatal)
   248				return nil
   249			}
   250	
   251			sessionID, _ := trailers.ParseSession(commit.Message)
   252	
   253			// Extract base commit from branch name (handles new "entire/<commit>-<worktreeHash>" format)
   254			baseCommit, _, _ := ParseShadowBranchName(branchName)
   255	
   256			results = append(results, EphemeralInfo{
   257				BranchName:   branchName,
   258				BaseCommit:   baseCommit,
   259				LatestCommit: ref.Hash(),
   260				SessionID:    sessionID,
   261				Timestamp:    commit.Author.When,
   262			})
   263	
   264			return nil
   265		})
   266	
   267		if err != nil {
   268			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to iterate branches: %w", err)
   269		}
   270	
   271		return results, nil
   272	}

   274	// writeTask writes a task checkpoint to a shadow branch.
   275	// Task checkpoints include both code changes and task-specific metadata.
   276	// Returns the commit hash of the created checkpoint.
   277	func (s *ephemeralStore) writeTask(ctx context.Context, opts WriteEphemeralTaskOptions) (plumbing.Hash, error) {
   278		// Validate base commit - required for shadow branch naming
   279		if opts.BaseCommit == "" {
   280			return plumbing.ZeroHash, errors.New("BaseCommit is required for task checkpoint")
   281		}
   282	
   283		// Validate identifiers to prevent path traversal and malformed data
   284		if err := validation.ValidateSessionID(opts.SessionID); err != nil {
   285			return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("invalid task checkpoint options: %w", err)
   286		}
   287		if err := validation.ValidateToolUseID(opts.ToolUseID); err != nil {
   288			return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("invalid task checkpoint options: %w", err)
   289		}
   290		if err := validation.ValidateAgentID(opts.AgentID); err != nil {
   291			return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("invalid task checkpoint options: %w", err)
   292		}
   293	
   294		// Get shadow branch name
   295		shadowBranchName := ShadowBranchNameForCommit(opts.BaseCommit, opts.WorktreeID)
   296	
   297		// Collect all files to include in the commit.
   298		// Filter out gitignored files — subagent transcripts may report files like .env
   299		// that exist on disk but are gitignored. Without filtering, secrets would leak
   300		// into the shadow branch.
   301		candidateFiles := make([]string, 0, len(opts.ModifiedFiles)+len(opts.NewFiles))
   302		candidateFiles = append(candidateFiles, opts.ModifiedFiles...)
   303		candidateFiles = append(candidateFiles, opts.NewFiles...)
   304		allFiles := filterGitIgnoredFiles(ctx, s.repo, candidateFiles)
   305	
   306		commonDir, err := s.repoCommonDir(ctx)
   307		if err != nil {
   308			return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to resolve repo dirs: %w", err)
   309		}
   310	
   311		var resultHash plumbing.Hash
   312		err = withShadowBranchFlock(commonDir, shadowBranchName, func() error {
   313			for attempt := range shadowRefMaxRetries {
   314				parentHash, baseTreeHash, gErr := s.getOrCreateShadowBranch(shadowBranchName, opts.BaseCommit)
   315				if gErr != nil {
   316					return fmt.Errorf("failed to get shadow branch: %w", gErr)
   317				}
   318	
   319				newTreeHash, tErr := s.buildTreeWithChanges(ctx, baseTreeHash, allFiles, opts.DeletedFiles, "", "")
   320				if tErr != nil {
   321					return fmt.Errorf("failed to build tree: %w", tErr)
   322				}
   323	
   324				newTreeHash, tErr = s.addTaskMetadataToTree(ctx, newTreeHash, opts)
   325				if tErr != nil {
   326					return fmt.Errorf("failed to add task metadata: %w", tErr)
   327				}
   328	
   329				commitHash, cErr := CreateCommit(ctx, s.repo, newTreeHash, parentHash, opts.CommitMessage, opts.AuthorName, opts.AuthorEmail)
   330				if cErr != nil {
   331					return fmt.Errorf("failed to create commit: %w", cErr)
   332				}
   333	
   334				refErr := casUpdateShadowBranchRef(ctx, s.repo, shadowBranchName, commitHash, parentHash)
   335				if refErr == nil {
   336					resultHash = commitHash
   337					return nil
   338				}
   339				if !errors.Is(refErr, ErrShadowRefBusy) {
   340					return fmt.Errorf("failed to update shadow branch reference: %w", refErr)
   341				}
   342				tryDeleteLooseObject(commonDir, commitHash)
   343				if bErr := shadowRefBackoff(ctx, attempt); bErr != nil {
   344					return bErr
   345				}
   346			}
   347			logging.Warn(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "checkpoint"),
   348				"shadow branch CAS retry budget exhausted (task checkpoint)",
   349				slog.String("shadow_branch", shadowBranchName),
   350				slog.Int("retries", shadowRefMaxRetries),
   351			)
   352			return fmt.Errorf("failed to update shadow branch reference after %d CAS retries: %w", shadowRefMaxRetries, ErrShadowRefBusy)
   353		})
   354		if err != nil {
   355			return plumbing.ZeroHash, err
   356		}
   357		return resultHash, nil
   358	}

   360	// addTaskMetadataToTree adds task checkpoint metadata to a git tree.
   361	// When IsIncremental is true, only adds the incremental checkpoint file.
   362	//
   363	// Uses ApplyTreeChanges (tree surgery) instead of FlattenTree+BuildTreeFromEntries,
   364	// so only affected subtrees are read/rebuilt.
   365	func (s *ephemeralStore) addTaskMetadataToTree(ctx context.Context, baseTreeHash plumbing.Hash, opts WriteEphemeralTaskOptions) (plumbing.Hash, error) {
   366		// Compute metadata paths
   367		sessionMetadataDir := paths.EntireMetadataDir + "/" + opts.SessionID
   368		taskMetadataDir := sessionMetadataDir + "/tasks/" + opts.ToolUseID
   369	
   370		var changes []TreeChange
   371	
   372		if opts.IsIncremental {
   373			// Incremental checkpoint: only add the checkpoint file
   374			var incData json.RawMessage
   375			if opts.IncrementalData != nil {
   376				redacted, redactErr := redact.JSONLBytes(opts.IncrementalData)
   377				if redactErr != nil {
   378					return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to redact incremental checkpoint: %w", redactErr)
   379				}
   380				incData = json.RawMessage(redacted.Bytes())
   381			}
   382			incrementalCheckpoint := struct {
   383				Type      string          `json:"type"`
   384				ToolUseID string          `json:"tool_use_id"`
   385				Timestamp time.Time       `json:"timestamp"`
   386				Data      json.RawMessage `json:"data"`
   387			}{
   388				Type:      opts.IncrementalType,
   389				ToolUseID: opts.ToolUseID,
   390				Timestamp: time.Now().UTC(),
   391				Data:      incData,
   392			}
   393			cpData, err := jsonutil.MarshalIndentWithNewline(incrementalCheckpoint, "", "  ")
   394			if err != nil {
   395				return plumbing.ZeroHash, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal incremental checkpoint: %w", err)
   396			}
   397

    17	// migrateShadowBranchIfNeeded checks if HEAD has changed since the session started
    18	// and either reconciles or migrates the shadow branch accordingly.
    19	//
    20	// Reconcile path: if HEAD carries this session's LastCheckpointID as an
    21	// Entire-Checkpoint trailer (e.g. after git reset --hard to a condensed commit),
    22	// both BaseCommit and AttributionBaseCommit are updated to HEAD. The old shadow
    23	// branch is intentionally left untouched to preserve rewind data.
    24	//
    25	// Migrate path: for all other HEAD changes (pull, rebase, tool-call commits),
    26	// the shadow branch is renamed to the new base and only BaseCommit is updated.
    27	// AttributionBaseCommit stays pinned for correct attribution.
    28	//
    29	// Returns (changed, reconciled, err):
    30	//   - changed: true if either path fired, false for no-op
    31	//   - reconciled: true only for the reconcile path; callers use this to know
    32	//     that attribution must be recomputed against the new base since the old
    33	//     base has been discarded (reconcile = reset-to-known-checkpoint)
    34	func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) migrateShadowBranchIfNeeded(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, state *SessionState) (bool, bool, error) {
    35		if state == nil || state.BaseCommit == "" {
    36			return false, false, nil
    37		}
    38	
    39		head, err := repo.Head()
    40		if err != nil {
    41			return false, false, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD: %w", err)
    42		}
    43	
    44		currentHead := head.Hash().String()
    45		if state.BaseCommit == currentHead {
    46			return false, false, nil // No migration needed
    47		}
    48	
    49		// Reconcile path: if HEAD sits on the exact commit carrying this session's
    50		// LastCheckpointID, the user has reset back to the last condensed
    51		// checkpoint. Update both BaseCommit and AttributionBaseCommit to HEAD.
    52		// Deliberately do NOT rename or touch the old shadow branch — it
    53		// preserves rewind data from the discarded segment of history.
    54		//
    55		// The SHA guard (currentHead == LastCheckpointCommitHash) distinguishes a
    56		// true reset from a cherry-pick/rebase that merely preserved the trailer.
    57		// Cherry-picking a checkpoint commit creates a new SHA with the same
    58		// message; firing reconcile in that case would drop the pinned
    59		// AttributionBaseCommit and corrupt attribution for uncondensed work.
    60		// Legacy state files without LastCheckpointCommitHash fall back to
    61		// trailer-only matching for backward compatibility.
    62		if !state.LastCheckpointID.IsEmpty() {
    63			shaMismatch := state.LastCheckpointCommitHash != "" && state.LastCheckpointCommitHash != currentHead
    64			if shaMismatch {

    66				// SHA doesn't match what we condensed into — fall through to migrate.

    74						if cpID.String() == state.LastCheckpointID.String() {
    75							state.BaseCommit = currentHead
    76							state.RealignAttributionBase(currentHead)
    77							logging.Info(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "migration"), "reconciled session to known checkpoint on HEAD",
    78								slog.String("checkpoint_id", state.LastCheckpointID.String()),
    79								slog.String("new_base", currentHead[:7]))
    80							return true, true, nil
    81						}
    82					}
    83				} else {
    84					logging.Warn(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "migration"), "could not load HEAD commit for reconcile check, falling through to migrate",
    85						slog.String("head", currentHead[:7]),
    86						slog.String("error", commitErr.Error()))
    87				}
    88			}
    89			// If SHA guard blocked, CommitObject failed, or no trailer matched,
    90			// fall through to the existing migrate path below.
    91		}

    97	// migrateShadowBranchToBaseCommit moves the current session's shadow branch to a
    98	// new base commit-derived name and updates state.BaseCommit. It returns whether
    99	// an existing shadow branch ref had to be migrated.
   100	func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) migrateShadowBranchToBaseCommit(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, state *SessionState, newBaseCommit string) (bool, error) {
   101		if state == nil || state.BaseCommit == "" || newBaseCommit == "" {
   102			return false, nil
   103		}
   104		if state.BaseCommit == newBaseCommit {
   105			return false, nil
   106		}
   107	
   108		// Base commit changed - check if old shadow branch exists and migrate it
   109		oldShadowBranch := checkpoint.ShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   110		newShadowBranch := checkpoint.ShadowBranchNameForCommit(newBaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   111	
   112		// Guard against hash prefix collision: if both commits produce the same
   113		// shadow branch name (same 7-char prefix), just update state - no ref rename needed
   114		if oldShadowBranch == newShadowBranch {
   115			state.BaseCommit = newBaseCommit
   116			return true, nil
   117		}
   118	
   119		oldRefName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(oldShadowBranch)
   120		oldRef, err := repo.Reference(oldRefName, true)
   121		if err != nil {
   122			if !errors.Is(err, plumbing.ErrReferenceNotFound) {
   123				return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to read shadow branch %s: %w", oldShadowBranch, err)
   124			}
   125			// Old shadow branch doesn't exist - just update state.BaseCommit
   126			// This can happen if this is the first checkpoint after HEAD changed
   127			state.BaseCommit = newBaseCommit
   128			logging.Info(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "migration"), "updated session base commit",
   129				slog.String("new_base", newBaseCommit[:7]))
   130			return true, nil
   131		}
   132	
   133		// Old shadow branch exists - move it to the new base commit atomically.
   134		if err := checkpoint.MoveShadowBranchIfUnchanged(ctx, repo, oldShadowBranch, newShadowBranch, oldRef.Hash()); err != nil {
   135			return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to move shadow branch %s to %s: %w", oldShadowBranch, newShadowBranch, err)
   136		}
   137	
   138		logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "migration")
   139	
   140		logging.Info(logCtx, "moved shadow branch (HEAD changed during session)",
   141			slog.String("from", oldShadowBranch),
   142			slog.String("to", newShadowBranch))
   143	
   144		// Update state with new base commit.
   145		// NOTE: AttributionBaseCommit is intentionally NOT updated here. Migration
   146		// renames the shadow branch but its checkpoint trees are still relative to
   147		// the original base. Attribution must diff from that original base to
   148		// correctly measure agent work captured in those checkpoints.
   149		state.BaseCommit = newBaseCommit
   150		return true, nil
   151	}

    17	// migrateShadowBranchIfNeeded checks if HEAD has changed since the session started
    18	// and either reconciles or migrates the shadow branch accordingly.
    19	//
    20	// Reconcile path: if HEAD carries this session's LastCheckpointID as an
    21	// Entire-Checkpoint trailer (e.g. after git reset --hard to a condensed commit),
    22	// both BaseCommit and AttributionBaseCommit are updated to HEAD. The old shadow
    23	// branch is intentionally left untouched to preserve rewind data.
    24	//
    25	// Migrate path: for all other HEAD changes (pull, rebase, tool-call commits),
    26	// the shadow branch is renamed to the new base and only BaseCommit is updated.
    27	// AttributionBaseCommit stays pinned for correct attribution.
    28	//
    29	// Returns (changed, reconciled, err):
    30	//   - changed: true if either path fired, false for no-op
    31	//   - reconciled: true only for the reconcile path; callers use this to know
    32	//     that attribution must be recomputed against the new base since the old
    33	//     base has been discarded (reconcile = reset-to-known-checkpoint)
    34	func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) migrateShadowBranchIfNeeded(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, state *SessionState) (bool, bool, error) {
    35		if state == nil || state.BaseCommit == "" {
    36			return false, false, nil
    37		}
    38	
    39		head, err := repo.Head()
    40		if err != nil {
    41			return false, false, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD: %w", err)
    42		}
    43	
    44		currentHead := head.Hash().String()
    45		if state.BaseCommit == currentHead {
    46			return false, false, nil // No migration needed
    47		}
    48	
    49		// Reconcile path: if HEAD sits on the exact commit carrying this session's
    50		// LastCheckpointID, the user has reset back to the last condensed
    51		// checkpoint. Update both BaseCommit and AttributionBaseCommit to HEAD.
    52		// Deliberately do NOT rename or touch the old shadow branch — it
    53		// preserves rewind data from the discarded segment of history.
    54		//
    55		// The SHA guard (currentHead == LastCheckpointCommitHash) distinguishes a
    56		// true reset from a cherry-pick/rebase that merely preserved the trailer.
    57		// Cherry-picking a checkpoint commit creates a new SHA with the same
    58		// message; firing reconcile in that case would drop the pinned
    59		// AttributionBaseCommit and corrupt attribution for uncondensed work.
    60		// Legacy state files without LastCheckpointCommitHash fall back to
    61		// trailer-only matching for backward compatibility.
    62		if !state.LastCheckpointID.IsEmpty() {
    63			shaMismatch := state.LastCheckpointCommitHash != "" && state.LastCheckpointCommitHash != currentHead
    64			if shaMismatch {
    65				// Trailer may still be present via cherry-pick/rebase, but the
    66				// SHA doesn't match what we condensed into — fall through to migrate.
    67				logging.Debug(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "migration"), "reconcile skipped: HEAD SHA does not match LastCheckpointCommitHash",
    68					slog.String("head", currentHead[:7]),
    69					slog.String("expected", state.LastCheckpointCommitHash[:7]))

    76							state.RealignAttributionBase(currentHead)

    78								slog.String("checkpoint_id", state.LastCheckpointID.String()),
    79								slog.String("new_base", currentHead[:7]))
    80							return true, true, nil
    81						}
    82					}
    83				} else {
    84					logging.Warn(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "migration"), "could not load HEAD commit for reconcile check, falling through to migrate",
    85						slog.String("head", currentHead[:7]),
    86						slog.String("error", commitErr.Error()))

    90			// fall through to the existing migrate path below.

    97	// migrateShadowBranchToBaseCommit moves the current session's shadow branch to a
    98	// new base commit-derived name and updates state.BaseCommit. It returns whether
    99	// an existing shadow branch ref had to be migrated.
   100	func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) migrateShadowBranchToBaseCommit(ctx context.Context, repo *git.Repository, state *SessionState, newBaseCommit string) (bool, error) {
   101		if state == nil || state.BaseCommit == "" || newBaseCommit == "" {
   102			return false, nil
   103		}
   104		if state.BaseCommit == newBaseCommit {
   105			return false, nil
   106		}
   107	
   108		// Base commit changed - check if old shadow branch exists and migrate it
   109		oldShadowBranch := checkpoint.ShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   110		newShadowBranch := checkpoint.ShadowBranchNameForCommit(newBaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   111	
   112		// Guard against hash prefix collision: if both commits produce the same
   113		// shadow branch name (same 7-char prefix), just update state - no ref rename needed
   114		if oldShadowBranch == newShadowBranch {
   115			state.BaseCommit = newBaseCommit
   116			return true, nil
   117		}
   118	
   119		oldRefName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(oldShadowBranch)
   120		oldRef, err := repo.Reference(oldRefName, true)
   121		if err != nil {
   122			if !errors.Is(err, plumbing.ErrReferenceNotFound) {
   123				return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to read shadow branch %s: %w", oldShadowBranch, err)
   124			}

   126			// This can happen if this is the first checkpoint after HEAD changed
   127			state.BaseCommit = newBaseCommit
   128			logging.Info(logging.WithComponent(ctx, "migration"), "updated session base commit",
   129				slog.String("new_base", newBaseCommit[:7]))
   130			return true, nil
   131		}
   132	
   133		// Old shadow branch exists - move it to the new base commit atomically.
   134		if err := checkpoint.MoveShadowBranchIfUnchanged(ctx, repo, oldShadowBranch, newShadowBranch, oldRef.Hash()); err != nil {
   135			return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to move shadow branch %s to %s: %w", oldShadowBranch, newShadowBranch, err)
   136		}
   137	
   138		logCtx := logging.WithComponent(ctx, "migration")
   139	
   140		logging.Info(logCtx, "moved shadow branch (HEAD changed during session)",
   141			slog.String("from", oldShadowBranch),
   142			slog.String("to", newShadowBranch))
   143	
   144		// Update state with new base commit.
   145		// NOTE: AttributionBaseCommit is intentionally NOT updated here. Migration
   146		// renames the shadow branch but its checkpoint trees are still relative to
   147		// the original base. Attribution must diff from that original base to
   148		// correctly measure agent work captured in those checkpoints.
   149		state.BaseCommit = newBaseCommit

    49	// mutateBranchCheckpointMetadata rewrites a checkpoint's root metadata.json on
    50	// the v1 branch tip (simulates older-CLI metadata).
    51	func mutateBranchCheckpointMetadata(t *testing.T, repo *git.Repository, cid id.CheckpointID, mutate func(map[string]any)) {
    52		t.Helper()
    53		ctx := context.Background()
    54		branchRef := DefaultV1Refs().Primary
    55		ref, err := repo.Reference(branchRef, true)
    56		require.NoError(t, err)
    57		commit, err := repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
    58		require.NoError(t, err)
    59		tree, err := commit.Tree()
    60		require.NoError(t, err)
    61	
    62		metaPath := cid.Path() + "/" + paths.MetadataFileName
    63		file, err := tree.File(metaPath)
    64		require.NoError(t, err)
    65		raw, err := file.Contents()
    66		require.NoError(t, err)
    67		var doc map[string]any
    68		require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal([]byte(raw), &doc))
    69		mutate(doc)
    70		edited, err := json.Marshal(doc)
    71		require.NoError(t, err)
    72	
    73		blobHash, err := CreateBlobFromContent(repo, edited)
    74		require.NoError(t, err)
    75		newTree, err := ApplyTreeChanges(ctx, repo, tree.Hash, []TreeChange{{
    76			Path:  metaPath,
    77			Entry: &object.TreeEntry{Name: metaPath, Mode: filemode.Regular, Hash: blobHash},
    78		}})
    79		require.NoError(t, err)
    80		commitHash, err := CreateCommit(ctx, repo, newTree, ref.Hash(), "test: legacy metadata", "Test", "test@test.com")
    81		require.NoError(t, err)
    82		require.NoError(t, repo.Storer.SetReference(plumbing.NewHashReference(branchRef, commitHash)))
    83	}

   109	func TestMigrateBranchToRefs(t *testing.T) {
   110		t.Parallel()
   111		repo, _ := setupBranchTestRepo(t)
   112		ctx := context.Background()
   113		branch := NewGitStore(repo, DefaultV1Refs())
   114	
   115		cid1 := id.MustCheckpointID("a1b2c3d4e5f6")
   116		cid2 := id.MustCheckpointID("b2c3d4e5f6a1")
   117		seedBranchCheckpoint(t, branch, cid1, "s1")
   118		seedBranchCheckpoint(t, branch, cid2, "s2")
   119	
   120		// cid1 carries legacy metadata: a checkpoint_version stamp plus an unmodeled field.
   121		mutateBranchCheckpointMetadata(t, repo, cid1, func(doc map[string]any) {
   122			doc["checkpoint_version"] = legacyCheckpointVersion
   123			doc["future_field"] = "keep-me"
   124		})
   125	
   126		result, err := MigrateBranchToRefs(ctx, repo, false)
   127		require.NoError(t, err)
   128		assert.Equal(t, 2, result.Total)
   129		assert.Len(t, result.Migrated, 2)
   130		assert.Equal(t, 0, result.Skipped)
   131	
   132		// Each ref carries the branch subtree with a normalized root metadata.json
   133		// and reads back through the git-refs store.
   134		branchTree, err := branch.getSessionsBranchTree(t.Context())
   135		require.NoError(t, err)
   136		refsStore := newGitRefsStore(repo)
   137		for _, cid := range []id.CheckpointID{cid1, cid2} {
   138			commit, err := repo.CommitObject(refHash(t, repo, cid))
   139			require.NoError(t, err)
   140	
   141			// Session contents carry over byte-identical; only the root
   142			// metadata.json is rewritten.
   143			branchSession, err := refsStore.subtreeObjAt(branchTree.Hash, cid.Path()+"/0")
   144			require.NoError(t, err)
   145			require.NotNil(t, branchSession)
   146			refSession, err := refsStore.subtreeObjAt(commit.TreeHash, "0")
   147			require.NoError(t, err)
   148			require.NotNil(t, refSession)
   149			assert.Equal(t, branchSession.Hash, refSession.Hash,
   150				"session subtree must be the branch's, byte-identical")
   151	
   152			// checkpoint_version is dropped; sessions[] paths are rebased to the ref root.
   153			doc := migratedMetadataDoc(t, repo, commit.TreeHash)
   154			assert.NotContains(t, doc, "checkpoint_version", "legacy version stamp must be dropped")
   155			sessions, ok := doc["sessions"].([]any)
   156			require.True(t, ok, "sessions must be an array")
   157			require.Len(t, sessions, 1)
   158			session, ok := sessions[0].(map[string]any)
   159			require.True(t, ok)
   160			assert.Equal(t, "/0/metadata.json", session["metadata"])
   161			assert.Equal(t, "/0/full.jsonl", session["transcript"])
   162			assert.Equal(t, "/0/prompt.txt", session["prompt"])
   163			assert.Equal(t, "/0/content_hash.txt", session["content_hash"])
   164	
   165			// A migration commit wraps the tree with no parent (orphan).
   166			assert.Empty(t, commit.ParentHashes, "first migration commit is an orphan")
   167	
   168			summary, err := refsStore.Read(ctx, cid)
   169			require.NoError(t, err)
   170			require.NotNil(t, summary, "migrated checkpoint should read via git-refs")
   171			assert.Equal(t, cid, summary.CheckpointID)
   172		}
   173	
   174		// Fields this CLI doesn't model survive the rewrite untouched.
   175		commit1, err := repo.CommitObject(refHash(t, repo, cid1))
   176		require.NoError(t, err)
   177		doc1 := migratedMetadataDoc(t, repo, commit1.TreeHash)
   178		assert.Equal(t, "keep-me", doc1["future_field"], "unknown metadata fields must be preserved")
   179	
   180		// Migrated refs are enqueued for push (the doctor's "push now" depends on it).
   181		queue, err := PushQueueForRepo(ctx, repo)
   182		require.NoError(t, err)
   183		queued, err := queue.Drain()
   184		require.NoError(t, err)
   185		wantQueued := make([]plumbing.ReferenceName, 0, 2)
   186		for _, cid := range []id.CheckpointID{cid1, cid2} {
   187			refName, err := RefName(cid)
   188			require.NoError(t, err)
   189			wantQueued = append(wantQueued, refName)
   190		}
   191		assert.ElementsMatch(t, wantQueued, queued, "migrated refs must be queued for push")
   192	
   193		// Idempotent: a second run skips everything and leaves the refs untouched.
   194		before := map[string]plumbing.Hash{cid1.String(): refHash(t, repo, cid1), cid2.String(): refHash(t, repo, cid2)}
   195		result2, err := MigrateBranchToRefs(ctx, repo, false)
   196		require.NoError(t, err)
   197		assert.Equal(t, 2, result2.Total)
   198		assert.Empty(t, result2.Migrated, "nothing to migrate on a repeat run")
   199		assert.Equal(t, 2, result2.Skipped)
   200		assert.Equal(t, before[cid1.String()], refHash(t, repo, cid1), "idempotent re-run must not move refs")
   201		assert.Equal(t, before[cid2.String()], refHash(t, repo, cid2))
   202	}
